Tulsa King (2022)
Tulsa King (2022) is a crime drama series starring Sylvester Stallone as Dwight “The General” Manfredi, a New York mafia capo who is released from prison after serving a 25-year sentence. Expecting to finally be welcomed back into his old criminal organization, Dwight instead discovers that the people he once trusted have sent him away to Tulsa, Oklahoma.
Far from the world he knows, Dwight arrives in Tulsa with little more than his experience, confidence, and old-school criminal instincts. Rather than allowing himself to be pushed aside, he begins building his own operation from the ground up. He recruits people around him, forms unexpected alliances, and slowly establishes himself in a city where he knows almost no one.
But building a criminal empire isn't easy, especially when Dwight's presence attracts attention from local criminals, law enforcement, and powerful enemies. His old-school way of doing business constantly clashes with a new generation, forcing him to adapt while still trying to maintain the respect and authority he believes he deserves.
The series explores themes of loyalty, betrayal, ambition, aging, family, power, identity, and starting over. Dwight may be a criminal, but his story is also about a man who realizes that the world he once belonged to has changed while he was away.
What makes Tulsa King entertaining is the contrast between Dwight's traditional mafia mentality and his unfamiliar surroundings. His confidence, humor, and willingness to take risks allow him to turn an unexpected exile into an opportunity to build something of his own.
More than just a gangster story, Tulsa King is about reinvention. After losing 25 years of his life, Dwight refuses to accept that his story is over. Instead, he decides to create a new empire—even if he has to build it from nothing.
💬 If you lost everything after 25 years, would you start over or walk away?

source_details.synopsis: Tulsa King is an American comedy and crime drama television series created by Taylor Sheridan for the streaming platform Paramount+. The series stars Sylvester Stallone as Dwight "The General" Manfredi, an American Mafia caporegime who has been recently released from prison in New York and is sent to Tulsa, Oklahoma, where he begins to set up a criminal organization. It is Stallone's first leading role in a scripted television series. The series also stars Andrea Savage, Martin Starr, Jay Will, Max Casella, Domenick Lombardozzi, Vincent Piazza, A. C.
